Did you know?

"My, bogowie, możemy niewiele zrobić by zachować pokój, zwłaszcza gdy kapłani opuszczają nasze świątynie. W tych mrocznych czasach to my musimy wierzyć w śmiertelników, a nie odwrotnie." — Kyrah, Bogini Muzyki

Did you know?

"BĘDZIEMY SOBIE WZAJEMNIE SŁUŻYĆ, w sposoby jakich oboje wymagamy."

Welcome to Plutonium!

We would like to remind you that neither Foundry nor Forge support piracy in any shape or form, and that all discussion related to the use of Plutonium should be done in our Discord.

Additionally, if you wish to screenshot or stream your game, we recommend Streamer Mode.

Did you know?

Kiedy Thylea wzniosła się w niebiosa, pozostało po niej święte drzewo w sercu jednej z wysp.

Did you know?

Pięciu Bogów pomogło Smoczym Lordom pokonać Sydona i Lutherię podczas Pierwszej Wojny.

Did you know?

Barbarzyńcy z Cerulańskiej Zatoki walczyli po stronie rdzennych ras przeciwko Smoczym Lordom.

Pass without Trace
2nd Level Abjuration (Cast at 3rd Level)
Casting Time1 action
Durationup to 1 hour
ComponentsV, S, M(ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce)
RangeSelf
ConcentrationRequires Concentration
A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +101d20+10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.

Axe of Xander
This is a sentient, lawful neutral +21d20+2 greataxe (Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 10). It has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 120 feet. It communicates empathically by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or using it.
The axe’s primary purpose is to destroy giants and titans. When you attack one of those creatures you score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. When attacking giants or titans Axe of Xander also deals an extra 2d62d6 force damage. It also transmits a tremendous sense of satisfaction and wellbeing to its user when it kills a giant or titan. You may heal 2d102d10 Hit Points when this happens.
This greataxe has 9 charges. As long as the weapon has at least 1 charge, attacks you make with it deal an extra 1d61d6 force damage to any target it hits. When you score a critical hit on an attack roll made with this weapon, it regains 3 expended charges.
Forceful Slash. When you take the Attack action using this axe, you can forgo one of your attacks to expend 3 or more of the greataxe's charges to slash the air in front you. When you do, a 30-foot cone of force emits from the blade. Creatures within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d61d6 force damage for each expended charge. If you expend 4 or more charges in this way and leave the Axe of Xander with 0 remaining charges, the weapon realses even more powerful wave of force. When it happens, targets within the area of effect take an extra 3d63d6 force damage, and creatures that succeed on the Dexterity saving throw take half damage instead of avoiding the effect, creatures that fail on the Dexterity Saving Throw are knocked prone. The DC for this property's saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the number of charges you expend.

Vortex Warp
2nd Level Conjuration
Casting Time1 action
DurationInstantaneous
ComponentsV, S
Range90ft.
You magically twist space around another creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (the target can choose to fail), or the target is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

At Higher levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range of the spell increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

Did you know?

"Jancanowie zawsze mnie fascynowali. Jak tacy genialni kowale mogli urodzić się wśród zwykłych cyklopów, którzy ledwo posiedli zdolność mówienia? To prawda, są rzadkością, ale najlepsi z nich mogą konkurować nawet z moim ojcem, Volkanem." — Vallus, Bogini Mądrości
